name: pathomitra
description: PathoMitra — Lab Management Simplified. Offline, on-device digital pathology laboratory management system — patient records, encrypted reports, billing and analytics.
author: Naitik Raj

scripts.build:android: node scripts/check-release-config.mjs && cross-env VITE_TARGET=native vite build && node scripts/check-native-assets.mjs
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:android && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('android/app/src/main/assets/public',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npx cap sync android && node scripts/check-native-assets.mjs --synced
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build-renderer && npm run desktop:bundle-main && electron .
scripts.build:desktop: node scripts/check-release-config.mjs && npm run desktop:build-renderer && node scripts/check-desktop-assets.mjs
scripts.desktop:msi: npm run build:desktop && npm run desktop:bundle-main && electron-builder --win msi --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.desktop:msi:test: node scripts/check-release-config.mjs --allow-placeholder && npm run desktop:build-renderer && npm run desktop:bundle-main && node scripts/check-desktop-assets.mjs && electron-builder --win msi --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run build:desktop && npm run desktop:bundle-main && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.desktop:installer:test: node scripts/check-release-config.mjs --allow-placeholder && npm run desktop:build-renderer && npm run desktop:bundle-main && node scripts/check-desktop-assets.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.desktop:msix: npm run build:desktop && npm run desktop:bundle-main && cross-env PM_WIN_TARGETS=appx electron-builder --win appx --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.build:android:test: node scripts/check-release-config.mjs --allow-placeholder && cross-env VITE_TARGET=native vite build && cross-env PATHOMITRA_ALLOW_PLACEHOLDER_ASSETS=1 node scripts/check-native-assets.mjs
scripts.sync:android:test: npm run build:android:test && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('android/app/src/main/assets/public',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npx cap sync android && cross-env PATHOMITRA_ALLOW_PLACEHOLDER_ASSETS=1 node scripts/check-native-assets.mjs --synced
scripts.android:test-build: npm run sync:android:test && npm run android:apk && npm run android:aab && npm run check:android
scripts.verify:android: npm run build:android && npm run android:aab && npm run check:android
scripts.verify: npm run lint:ci && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
